title: Detoxifying Large Language Models via Knowledge Editing

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the defense success rate (DS) and defense generalization (DG) of models against adversarial queries designed to elicit prejudiced responses, using a fine-tuned RoBERTa-large safety classifier to judge the safety of the generated text.
Measuring the safety of model responses to adversarial queries targeting political views, figures, and policy decisions using a fine-tuned RoBERTa-large safety classifier.
